ConsoleKey.help: Set key that opens the console

ClientCastLimitDebug.help: Limits the maximum allowed initiated casts in progress.

DebugTorsoTwist.help: Debug visualization for Torso Twist: 1 = Player, 2 = Target, 3 = All

ForceGenerateSlug.help: Generate .slug files for all loaded fonts before they are actually used rather than deferred load.

InvalidateDeactivatedHandles.help: Turn on to treat WowCS Handles as invalid if referring to a deactivated entity

SlugOpticalWeight.help: When rendering, coverage values are remapped to increase the optical weight of the glyphs. This can improve the appearance of small text, but usually looks good only for dark text on a light background.

SplineOpt.help: toggles use of spline coll optimization

addonLoadDebugging.help: 0: Disable addon load logging (Default), 1: Enable addon load logging to AddOnLoad.log.

consoleShowDebugMessages.help: Controls if log messages with Debug priority are displayed to console.

consoleShowSpamMessages.help: Controls if log messages with Spam priority are displayed to console.

developerLogFilterDebug.help: Show Debug messages in Developer Log - 0: Disabled (default), 1: Enabled.

developerLogFilterError.help: Show Error messages in Developer Log - 0: Disabled, 1: Enabled (default).

developerLogFilterFatal.help: Show Fatal messages in Developer Log - 0: Disabled, 1: Enabled (default).

developerLogFilterNormal.help: Show Normal messages in Developer Log - 0: Disabled, 1: Enabled (default).

developerLogFilterSpam.help: Show Spam messages in Developer Log - 0: Disabled (default), 1: Enabled.

developerLogFilterWarning.help: Show Warning messages in Developer Log - 0: Disabled, 1: Enabled (default).

developerLogWriteToFile.help: Enables Developer Log Write to File - 0: Disabled, 1: Enabled (default).

disableUILoadErrorDialog.help: Disables showing an os dialog on critical UI error startup

enableMemoryTrap.help: Whether memory access trapping is enabled.  Disabling may slightly improve performance, but at the cost of less information when memory access violations occur.

enableRefHistory.help: Whether ref history tracking is enabled.  Disabling may slightly improve performance, but at the cost of less information when leaks occur.

enableSourceLocationLookup.help: Allows addon file name lookup for debugging help

frameScriptFunctionInheritanceWarningMod.help: Displays Lua errors about script handlers that are using inheritance improperly (might add more modes in the future, 0 is off, 1 is on)

fstack_enabled.help: 0: Hide Framestack Tooltip (Default), 1: Show Framestack Tooltip.

fstack_showRaisedFrameLevels.help: 0: Show normal frame levels (default), 1: Show raised frame levels instead

persistMoveLogOnTransfer.help: Set to 1 to automatically re-enable logging on the current movelog target after a transfer

scriptProfile.help: Whether or not script profiling is enabled

scriptWarnings.help: Whether or not the UI shows Lua warnings

taintLog.help:
Controls debug logging of Lua taint and restricted action events to the 'taint.log' file:
0: Disable all logging
1: Log blocked action errors and taint events leading up to them
2: Log tainted reads and writes of global variables
3: Log tainted reads and writes of upvalues
4: Log tainted reads and writes of table fields

taintLogObjectSecrets.help: If enabled, include additional taint log entries when script objects gain secret aspects or values.

AftermathCallstacks.help: Enables NVIDIA Aftermath callstack capturing (high CPU cost)

AllowWinRT.help: Disable if WoW is crashing due to issues with the Windows GameBar

ChromaEffectsEnable.help: Enable chroma effects on supported peripherals

ChromaEffectsFactionColor.help: Enable setting chroma base layer color to match current faction

ClipCursor.help: Lock the cursor to the game window

CursorCenteredYPos.help: 0-1 vertical position of centered cursor/targeting (0 at bottom)

CursorFreelookCentering.help: Center the cursor when using Mouse freelook

CursorFreelookStartDelta.help: Fraction of the screen the cursor must move to start freelook after mouse button goes down

CursorStickyCentering.help: Make the centered position stick after freelook; Don't restore previous cursor position

DeprecatedWarningThrottle.help: Time since last warning. A value of "1" will disable this message

ExclusiveWindowMode.help: Accessibility option for preventing the game window from losing focus

ForceResolutionDefaultToMaxSize.help: Force default resolution to the maximum supported size rather than the auto-detected size

GamePadAnalogMovement.help: Enable analog movement in any direction, rather than just the 8 cardinal directions

GamePadCameraLookMaxPitch.help: Max pitch 'Look' stick can adjust camera angle

GamePadCameraLookMaxYaw.help: Max yaw 'Look' stick can adjust camera angle

GamePadCursorAutoDisableJump.help: GamePad cursor control will auto-disable when you jump

GamePadCursorAutoDisableSticks.help: GamePad cursor control will auto-disable on stick input (0=none, 1=movement, 2=movement+cursor)

GamePadCursorAutoEnable.help: Auto enable GamePad cursor control when opening UIs that may need it

GamePadCursorCenteredEmulation.help: When cursor is centered for GamePad movement, also emulate mouse clicks

GamePadCursorCentering.help: When using GamePad, center the cursor

GamePadCursorForTargeting.help: Enable GamePad controlled cursor for spell targeting (1=enable, 2=start-at-target)

GamePadCursorLeftClick.help: GamePad button that should emulate mouse Left Click while controlling the mouse cursor

GamePadCursorOnLogin.help: Enable GamePad cursor control on login and character screens

GamePadCursorPushCamera.help: Rate for GamePad controlled cursor to push/turn camera when at edge of window

GamePadCursorRightClick.help: GamePad button that should emulate mouse Right Click while controlling the mouse cursor

GamePadCursorSpeedAccel.help: Acceleration of GamePad cursor per second as it continues to move

GamePadCursorSpeedMax.help: Top speed of GamePad cursor movement

GamePadCursorSpeedStart.help: Speed of GamePad cursor when it starts moving

GamePadEmulateAlt.help: GamePad button that should emulate the Alt key

GamePadEmulateCtrl.help: GamePad button that should emulate the Ctrl key

GamePadEmulateShift.help: GamePad button that should emulate the Shift key

GamePadEmulateTapWindowMs.help: GamePad buttons emulating Ctrl/Alt/Shift will be 'tapped' if released withing this time in MS

GamePadEnable.help: Whether GamePad input should be enabled

GamePadFaceMovementMaxAngle.help: Max movement to camera angle to face movement direction instead of camera direction. 0 = always, 180 = never (115 allows using strafe with quick turn around)

GamePadFaceMovementMaxAngleCombat.help: Max movement to camera angle to face movement direction instead of camera direction, in combat. 0 = always, 180 = never (115 allows using strafe with quick turn around)

GamePadFactionColor.help: Enable setting GamePad's led color to match current faction

GamePadOverlapMouseMs.help: Duration after gamepad+mouse input to switch to just one or the other.

GamePadRunThreshold.help: 0-1 Amount of stick movement before character transitions from walk to run

GamePadSingleActiveID.help: ID of single GamePad device to use. 0 = Use all devices' combined input

GamePadStickAxisButtons.help: Enables virtual buttons for the GamePad stick cardinal directions

GamePadTankTurnSpeed.help: If non-zero, character turns like a tank from GamePad movement

GamePadTouchCursorEnable.help: Enable cursor control with GamePad's touch pad (0=disable, 1=enable, 2=enable in mkb ui / disable in gamepad ui)

GamePadTouchCursorMoveThreshold.help: Change before touchpad moves the cursor (larger for easier taps)

GamePadTouchTapButtons.help: Enable touch tap to press TouchPad buttons

GamePadTouchTapMaxMs.help: Max time in ms for a touch to register a tap/click

GamePadTouchTapOnlyClick.help: Only use taps for cursor clicks, do not use tap presses

GamePadTouchTapRightClick.help: Taps for cursor clicks are right clicks instead of left clicks

GamePadTurnWithCamera.help: Turn character to match when camera facing is changed (1=in-combat, 2=always, 3=in-combat or casting)

GxAllowCachelessShaderMode.help: CPU memory saving mode, if supported by backend. When enabled, shaders are fetched from disk as needed instead of being kept resident. This mode may slightly increase the time objects take to appear the first time they are encountered. Computers without solid state drives may want to disable this feature

GxCompatAllowSM6.help: When disabled, DX12 will use Shader Model 5 shaders instead of Shader Model 6

GxCompatAsyncComputeQueue.help: Allows some compute work to run on a different GPU work queue

GxCompatAsyncShaderCompilation.help: Allows async resource shader loading. Disabling this may cause hitching

GxCompatCommandListMultiThreading.help: Allow multi-threaded rendering. Disabling this will significantly reduce framerate

GxCompatCopyQueue.help: Allows GPU upload work to run on a different GPU work queue

GxCompatLowLatencyCallbacks.help: Allows GPU -> CPU readbacks to be checked for more frequently rather than always taking the max GPU frame latency

GxCompatOptionalGpuFeatures.help: When disabled, makes the engine act as if the GPU only supports the minimum supported feature set

GxCompatWorkSubmitOptimizations.help: Allows GPU work submission on a secondary thread while the rest of the CPU threads continue on to the next frame

GxMaxFrameLatency.help: maximum number of frames ahead of GPU the CPU can be

GxMonitor.help: Monitor index. 0 means use the primary monitor

GxSlowShaderWarnThreshold.help: Max time (in milliseconds) the shader compile can take before warning via a popup message

MaxObservedPetBattles.help: Maximum number of observed pet battles

NotchedDisplayMode.help: Do nothing = 0. Shift UI down = 1. Shift everything down = 2.

PreemptiveCastEnable.help: Enable preemptive triggering of cast visuals based on spell release timing

TTSUseCharacterSettings.help: If character-specific TTS settings are being used.

TurnSpeed.help: Set the keyboard turn rate in degrees per second; capped by the server

casContainerSizeLimit.help: Approximate limit in GB for the amount of game data to keep on disk at a time

debugAllocSingleBlade.help: At startup only, choose a single blade such as a CSI peer to have debug allocators

debugAllocTrackStacktrace.help: Whether to track the stacktrace for each debug allocation

disableAutoRealmSelect.help: Disable automatically selecting a realm on login

enableRuneSpentAnim.help: Adjust the time the rune fades after it flashes when you spend it

enableWowMouse.help: Enable Steelseries World of Warcraft Mouse

initialRealmListTimeout.help: How long to wait for the initial realm list before failing login (in seconds)

reloadUIOnAspectChange.help: Reload the UI on aspect change

runeFadeTime.help: Adjust the time the rune fades from on CD to ready

runeSpentFadeTime.help: Adjust the time the base rune takes to fade out after the rune flash fades out

runeSpentFlashTime.help: Adjust the time the rune flash takes to fade out

telemetryWowPackage.help: The primary package we want to send telemetry to e.g. Wow_Mainline or Wow_Classic

telemetryWowlabsPackage.help: The secondary package we want to send telemetry to e.g. Wow_Wowlabs

webChallengeURLTimeout.help: How long to wait for the web challenge URL (in seconds). 0 means wait forever.

ActionButtonUseKeyDown.help: Activate the action button on a keydown

ActionButtonUseKeyHeldSpell.help: Activate the press and hold cast option on a keydown

AdvFlyingDynamicFOVEnabled.help: Enables adjustment of camera field of view based on gliding speed

AllowSpectateMode.help: Enables spectate/commentator camera to be used.

AutoPushSpellToActionBar.help: Determines if spells are automatically pushed to the Action Bar. 0: No, 1: Yes (default).

CAASayYourDebuffsVolume.help: Volume of player debuff combat audio alerts (0 to 100)

CAATargetCastVolume.help: Volume of target cast combat audio alerts (0 to 100)

CAAVoice.help: Primary voice to use for combat audio alerts

CAAVolume.help: Volume of combat audio alerts (0 to 100)

CameraFollowGamepadAdjustDelay.help: Delay before follow resuming after manually adjusting the camera with Gamepad input

CameraFollowGamepadAdjustEaseIn.help: Ease-in time for follow resuming after manually adjusting the camera with Gamepad input

CameraFollowOnStick.help: Enable camera to follow target as though being pushed/pulled along on a stick

CameraFollowPitchOffset.help: Controls the pitch offset in degrees that the camera will move towards

CameraFollowSnapCharacterAngle.help: Angle beyond which character will snap to camera's facing when moving

CameraFollowTargetCombat.help: Camera follow the locked target only during combat.

CameraKeepCharacterCentered.help: Motion sickness control to keep character's head at center of screen to act as motion reference point. Can override other cvar settings.

CameraReduceUnexpectedMovement.help: Motion sickness control to reduce camera movement without player input. Can override other cvar settings.

DisableAdvancedFlyingFullScreenEffects.help: Disable the advanced flying full screen effects

DisableAdvancedFlyingVelocityVFX.help: Disable the advanced flying velocity VFX

DriveDynamicFOVEnabled.help: Enables adjustment of camera field of view based on driving speed

DriveSwapReverseTurnDirection.help: Boolean indicating if we should swap turn directions when driving in reverse. By default, Drive uses the opposite turn direction when moving backwards.

EJDungeonDifficulty.help: Stores the last dungeon difficulty viewed in the encounter journal

EJLootClass.help: Stores the last class that loot was filtered by in the encounter journal

EJLootSpec.help: Stores the last spec that loot was filtered by in the encounter journal

EJRaidDifficulty.help: Stores the last raid difficulty viewed in the encounter journal

EJSelectedTier.help: Stores the last manually selected journal tier in the encounter journal

EmitterCombatRange.help: Range to stop shoulder/weapon emissions during combat

EmpowerTapControlsReleaseThreshold.help: Sets the time in milliseconds after which release/re-hold requests will be registered for press-and-tap empowers. Begins when the cast is sent from the client.

EnableBlinkApplicationIcon.help: Allows the client to blink the application icon in the taskbar in Windows, or bounce the application icon in the dock on macOS

GamePadBackPedalThreshold.help: Stick magnitude threshold to face the movement direction instead of back pedal

GamePadCameraPitchSpeed.help: Pitch speed of GamePad camera moving up/down

GamePadCameraYawSpeed.help: Yaw speed of GamePad camera turning left/right

GamePadFaceMovementFreeFlying.help: Always face movement direction when free flying and not in combat

GamePadFaceMovementMount.help: Always face movement direction when riding a land mount

GamePadFaceMovementSwimming.help: Always face movement direction when swimming and not in combat

GamepadCameraFollowOnStick.help: Enable camera to follow target as though being pushed/pulled along on a stick

GamepadCameraFollowPitchOffset.help: Controls the pitch offset in degrees that the camera will move towards

GamepadCompassCustomFilterBoss.help: Adds Boss icons to the compass's custom filter.

GamepadCompassCustomFilterCritter.help: Adds Critter icons to the compass's custom filter.

GamepadCompassCustomFilterEnemy.help: Adds Enemy icons to the compass's custom filter.

GamepadCompassCustomFilterFriendly.help: Adds Friendly icons to the compass's custom filter.

GamepadCompassCustomFilterParty.help: Adds Party icons to the compass's custom filter.

GamepadConstrainedGroundTargetDistanceYd.help: [Gamepad Specific] Distance at which to constrain AOE spell range to.

GamepadConstrainedGroundTargetEnabled.help: [Gamepad Specific] Whether AOE offer constrained-range casting.

GamepadConstrainedGroundTargetMaxRange.help: [Gamepad Specific] Max Range at which to AOE spells become cursor-targeted.

GamepadDisableTooltips.help: Disables tooltips in gamepad mode when in a focused menu.

GamepadFocusStateColor.help: Determines which focus state color to use.

GamepadFocusStateOpacity.help: Determines opacity to use for focus state. Set to 0 for no glow.

GamepadHudModifierUsesToggle.help: Allows the HUD Modifier state to be toggled on/off when tapped instead of when held/released.

GamepadMapEdgePanDistance.help: The distance from the edge of the map screen that will cause it to pan.

GamepadMapScrollSpeed.help: How fast the map is scrolled.

GamepadMapScrollSpeedFullScreen.help: How fast the map is scrolled when the map is full screen.

GamepadMapZoomSpeed.help: How fast the map is zoomed in or out.

GamepadPossessBarOverride.help: Specifies which of the gamepad action bars is overriden by the possess action bar when it is available.

GamepadPreferScreenTargeting.help: Use Screen Targeting instead of the Targeting Radial.

GamepadRaidTargetingHoverMode.help: When raid targeting spells will target the indicated player without changing the player's current target.

GamepadRaidTargetingStyle.help: The type of targeting style to use when targeting players in a raid group.

GamepadShowActionBarButtonPrompts.help: Indicates if the input prompts should be displayed on the active gamepad action bar.

GamepadShowActionBarHighlight.help: Indicates if the highlight should be displayed on the active gamepad action bar.

GamepadShowActionBarScaling.help: Indicates if the scaling should be enabled on the active gamepad action bar.

GamepadShowAutoAuraTooltip.help: Whether to automatically show buff tooltips for Gamepad UI

GamepadShowEmptyActionbars.help: Show additional action bars even if they have no abilities bound.

GamepadShowPersistentInputLegend.help: Indicates if the list of gamepad actions should always be shown on screen.

GamepadStanceBarOverride.help: Specifies which of the gamepad action bars is overriden by the stance action bar when it is available.

GamepadSwapFriendlyTargetActions.help: Swaps the dpad and face button actions when holding the friendly target modifier.

GamepadSwapHostileTargetActions.help: Swaps the dpad and face button actions when holding the hostile target modifier.

GamepadSwapTargetModifiers.help: Swaps the friendly and hostile target modifiers.

GamepadTabFriendlyTargetAction.help: Tab target friendlies on target action release

GamepadTabHostileTargetAction.help: Tab target hostiles on target action release

GamepadTargetingAnalogDeadzone.help: Magnitude of input the stick must receive for analog targeting to take effect (0.0-1.0)

GamepadTargetingAnalogPullbackThreshold.help: Magnitude difference at which analog targeting turns itself off (0.0-1.0)

GamepadUsePartyTargeting.help: If enabled, target specific party members with the dpad rather than using directional targeting

ImpactModelCollisionMelee.help: Enable model collision checks for melee impact effects

ImpactModelCollisionMissile.help: Enable model collision checks for missile impact effects

ImpactModelCollisionRanged.help: Enable model collision checks for ranged attack impact effects

MouseHiddenInRelativeMode.help: Disabling may work around issues in relative mode in some rare cases

NonEmitterCombatRange.help: Range to stop shoulder/weapon emissions outside combat

ReplaceMyPlayerPortrait.help: Replaces local player's unit frame portrait with their class icon

ReplaceOtherPlayerPortraits.help: Replaces other player unit frame portraits with their class icon

ShakeStrengthCamera.help: Motion sickness control for how much effects can shake the camera

ShakeStrengthUI.help: Motion sickness control for how much effects can shake in 2D UI

ShowAllSpellRanks.help: show either all spell ranks, or only the highest rank

ShowQuestUnitCircles.help: Determines if units related to a quest display an indicator on the ground.

SmartNavigationCursorAnchor.help: What edge of the cursor to anchor to the button.

SmartNavigationCursorAppearance.help: What appearance for the cursor to take.

SmartNavigationCursorButtonAnchor.help: Where in relation to the button to anchor the cursor.

SmartNavigationCursorFlipHorizontal.help: Flips smart cursor horizontally, making left right.

SmartNavigationCursorFlipVertical.help: Flips smart cursor vertically, making up down.

SmartNavigationCursorRotationAngle.help: How much to rotate the smart cursor, in degrees.

SmartNavigationScrollSpeed.help: How fast areas are scrolled using the right stick.

SoftTargetEnemy.help: Sets when enemy soft targeting should be enabled. 0=off, 1=gamepad, 2=KBM, 3=always

SoftTargetEnemyArc.help: 0 = No yaw arc allowance, must be directly in front. 1 = Must be in front yaw arc. 2 = Can be anywhere in tab targeting area.

SoftTargetEnemyRange.help: Max range to soft target enemies (limited to tab targeting range)

SoftTargetForce.help: Auto-set target to match soft target. 1 = for enemies, 2 = for friends

SoftTargetFriend.help: Sets when friend soft targeting should be enabled. 0=off, 1=gamepad, 2=KBM, 3=always

SoftTargetFriendArc.help: 0 = No yaw arc allowance, must be directly in front. 1 = Must be in front yaw arc. 2 = Can be anywhere in targeting area.

SoftTargetFriendRange.help: Max range to soft target friends (limited to tab targeting range)

SoftTargetIconEnemy.help: Show icon for soft enemy target

SoftTargetIconFriend.help: Show icon for soft friend target

SoftTargetIconGameObject.help: Show icon for sot interact game objects (interactable objects you cannot normally target)

SoftTargetIconInteract.help: Show icon for soft interact target

SoftTargetInteract.help: Sets when soft interact should be enabled. 0=off, 1=gamepad, 2=KBM, 3=always

SoftTargetInteractArc.help: 0 = No yaw arc allowance, must be directly in front. 1 = Must be in front yaw arc. 2 = Can be anywhere in targeting area.

SoftTargetInteractOnlyInRange.help: Sets if soft interacts should only be set for targets that are in interact range.

SoftTargetInteractRange.help: Max range to soft target interacts (limited to tab targeting and individual interact ranges)

SoftTargetInteractRangeIsHard.help: Sets if it should be a hard range cutoff, even for something you can interact with right now.

fields.description: A flooded night elf ruin on the Zoram Strand, occupied by naga, murlocs and Twilight's Hammer cultists serving Aku'mai.
Someone has broken into the royal dwarven burial chamber beneath Ironforge.
Troggs and Burning Blade cultists infest the molten caverns beneath Orgrimmar.
Scourge forces still haunt the ruined capital while a necromancer gathers power within the city.
Archmage Arugal and his worgen followers hold the keep above Pyrewood Village.
The Defias Brotherhood is building a warship in the mines beneath Moonbrook.
Defias prisoners have overrun Stormwind's prison beneath the Canal District.
Deep beneath the Barrens, druids and fanglords guard the sleeping Naralex while twisted beasts prowl the caverns.

strings.AUCTIONATOR_L_CONFIG_SELLING_GEAR_VENDOR: This lets you set a default price for gear as a multiple of the vendor price. This is used for any gear Auctionator doesn't have a price for. Set this to 0 to not set a price.
strings.AUCTIONATOR_L_CONFIG_SELLING_GREY_POST_B: Grey (disable) the post button when a post may fail
When a post may fail the post button will be greyed out (disabled). Turn this option off to avoid waiting for the button to enable so you can attempt to post sooner.
strings.AUCTIONATOR_L_CONFIG_SELLING_ICON_SIZE_T: This lets you make the bag item icons in the selling tab larger (up to 50) or smaller (down to 10). Default size is 42.

Show favourite/custom group items in the bag view even when they aren't in your bag.
strings.AUCTIONATOR_L_CONFIG_SELLING_POSSESSED_F: In favourites/custom groups place items you have in your bag first
Show possessed favourite/custom group items first
Set the favourite/custom group ordering to force any items in your bag to be at the start of the list.
strings.AUCTIONATOR_L_CONFIG_SELLING_POST_SHORTC: A keyboard/mouse shortcut to post the current item is

strings.CHOOSE_GLYPHS_HELP:
At maximum level, you will have the choice of three major and three minor glyphs. Major glyphs change the way some of your spells or abilities function, while minor glyphs offer cosmetic or small utility benefits.

You must acquire a glyph before you can choose it. Glyphs are produced by characters with the Inscription profession. You can get glyphs by trading with another player or by visiting an Auction House.

You can reset all of your glyphs by visiting a class trainer or swap specific glyphs by using an item called %s.
strings.CHOOSE_GLYPHS_NOW: Your character can now choose glyphs.
strings.CHOOSE_SPECIALIZATION_HELP:
Your character can now choose a class specialization. Specializations confer new abilities at level 10, and provide additional abilities at higher level. Most specializations use different attacks or spells than other specializations in the same class.

Some specializations allow you to fulfill different roles, such as tanking or healing. You can change your specialization at any time by visiting a class trainer.
strings.CHOOSE_SPECIALIZATION_NOW: Your character can now choose a class specialization.
strings.CHOOSE_TALENTS_HELP:
Talents are special abilities, some of which are active attacks or spells that you can put on your action bar, and some of which are passive abilities.

Ideally, there are no right or wrong talent choices for your character. You should make a choice based on what sounds fun or complements your play style. Every time you choose a talent, you pick from one of three options.

You can reset all of your talents by visiting a class trainer or you can choose different talents in one row by using an item called %s.
strings.CHOOSE_TALENTS_NOW: Your character can now choose talents.
strings.CHOOSE_THE_ALLIANCE:
The noble races of the Alliance are bound together by proud traditions of nobility, honor, faith, justice, and sacrifice.

The many different Alliance peoples all contribute their technical, arcane, and spiritual wisdom toward the goal of a peaceful and just world.

Take up their banner to represent the high ideals of the Alliance throughout Azeroth and beyond.
strings.CHOOSE_THE_HORDE:
The proud nations of the Horde are loosely joined in an alliance of convenience against a hostile world that would see them destroyed.

Focused, ferocious, and sometimes monstrous, the Horde values strength and honor, but struggles to keep aggression in check.

Join the Horde and fight to build a world where their people can live free.

strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_FEATURE_ADVENTURES_NIGH: Help protect the realm, and maintain balance in Ardenweald. Recruit companions and troops to send them out on a series of adventures across the Shadowlands.
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_FEATURE_ADVENTURES_VENT: Restore pride in Revendreth among our forces as we continue to fight for all Venthyr. Recruit companions and troops to send them out on a series of adventures across the Shadowlands.
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_FEATURE_ANIMACONDUCTOR: An ancient device that allows you to spend Anima in order to activate bonus content in different area of your covenant's home zone
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_FEATURE_ANIMACONDUCTOR_: Restore anima to this powerful and ancient device. Once operational it allows you to siphon anima to different parts of Bastion in order to activate new challenges and adventures.
Restore anima to this powerful and ancient device. Once operational it allows you to siphon anima to different parts of Maldraxxus in order to activate new challenges and adventures.
Restore anima to this powerful and ancient device. Once operational it allows you to siphon anima to different parts of Ardenweald in order to activate new challenges and adventures.
Restore anima to this powerful and ancient device. Once operational it allows you to siphon anima to different parts of Revendreth in order to activate new challenges and adventures.
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_FEATURE_TRAVELNETWORK: A transportation network that offers you more fast travel options across your covenant's home zone
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_FEATURE_TRAVELNETWORK_K: Restore anima to the dormant transportation portals that once linked all of Bastion. Further empower the network to expand on your travel options. Develop and enhance your abilities tied to the network.
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_FEATURE_TRAVELNETWORK_N: Reactivate the Sanctum's access to the massive Necropolis' that dominate the sky above Maldraxxus. Restore access to more travel options within the zone, and discover hidden secrets. Use that access to earn unique rewards.

Restore the mysterious Mushroom ring network that once brought all of Ardenweald together. Grants access to more travel options within the zone, and opens up new paths of discovery across Ardenweald with their own unique rewards.
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_FEATURE_TRAVELNETWORK_V: Reactivate the mysterious network of mirrors that connect across Revendreth. Continue to restore the network to earn the ability to repair broken mirrors across Revendreth that can be used to access secret locations and unique rewards.

strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_RESERVOIR_INACTIVE: The Sanctum Reservoir is currently inactive
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_TUTORIAL1: This pane shows rewards earned by increasing your Renown with the Covenant

strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_TUTORIAL3: Milestones are noteworthy rewards of higher value

strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_UNIQUE_KYRIAN: An ancient rite of combat in which you act as a tactical guide for champions of Bastion, testing their mettle against a series of powerful foes.
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_UNIQUE_NECROLORD: This nexus of the Maldraxxian art of fleshcrafting allows you to construct new companions to join you on your adventures across the Shadowlands.
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_UNIQUE_NIGHTFAE: A sacred garden where you can nurture the wildseeds of powerful lost souls and prepare them for rebirth.
strings.COVENANT_SANCTUM_UNIQUE_VENTHYR: Help rebuild Prince Renathal's influence through the most venerated of venthyr traditions: throwing amazing parties! Make proper preparations and recruit the right staff to impress each week's VIP guests.

strings.GUILD_INTEREST_QUEST_TOOLTIP: Quests are tasks that can be completed by solo players or groups in the outdoor world.
strings.GUILD_INTEREST_RAID_TOOLTIP: Raids are similar to dungeons, but more epic in scale, rewards, and challenge. Raids require groups of 10 to 30 players to complete.
strings.GUILD_INTEREST_RP_TOOLTIP: Role Playing is a specific type of gameplay where players stay in character at all times.  Players generally role play via in game emotes and chat.

strings.HELPFRAME_REPORT_ABUSE_HELP: The safety and well-being of our players is extremely important to us.  Should you find that a player is behaving in a manner that is personally offensive to you or others, or may have a character name that is in violation of our Terms of Use, you have a quick venue to express those concerns. You can quickly and efficiently report players by right-clicking their name in chat and selecting Report Player.
strings.HELPFRAME_REPORT_BUG_TEXT1:
If you have stumbled onto a bug, we will need as much detail as possible to find and fix it. Using the field below, please describe the issue:

-|cffffd200Be specific|r about every step that leads to the problem.
-Include any relevant |cffffd200character names, NPCs, and locations|r.
-|cffffd200Avoid typos or abbreviations|r, which make bugs much harder to track down.
-Include |cffffd200how long|r you have been seeing the problem, and |cffffd200how often|r (if more than once).
strings.HELPFRAME_REPORT_PLAYER_TEXT1:
World of Warcraft is intended to be a fun, fair, and safe environment. If you encounter a player who is using an |cffffd200offensive name|r, is |cffffd200spamming|r in chat, |cffffd200cheating|r, or using |cffffd200foul language|r, there's a quick and easy way to report the problem to Blizzard for follow-up.

To report a player for rule-breaking or offensive behavior, |cffffd200right-click the player's name|r in chat, or |cffffd200right-click the player's portrait|r, and select the option to |cffffd200Report Player|r.

strings.HUNTER_BM_CORE_ABILITY_2: Ability that causes your pet to enter a frenzy, dealing damage and gaining increased attack speed for a duration.
strings.HUNTER_BM_CORE_ABILITY_3: Ability that spends Focus and causes your primary pet to deal a large attack.
strings.HUNTER_BM_CORE_ABILITY_4: Ranged attack that spends Focus, hitting your target and all nearby enemies, and causing your primary pet's attacks to hit multiple targets.
strings.HUNTER_BM_CORE_ABILITY_5: Ability with a cooldown that causes you and your primary pet to deal increased damage for its duration.
strings.HUNTER_BM_CORE_ABILITY_6: Ability with a long cooldown that causes you and your primary pet to have increased critical strike chance and Focus generation for its duration.

Increases |cFFFFFFFFMelee Weapon|r damage per second by %s

Increased by |cFFFFFFFFStrength|r and |cFFFFFFFFAgility|r

strings.HUNTER_MM_CORE_ABILITY_2: Strong ranged cast-time attack that spends Focus.
strings.HUNTER_MM_CORE_ABILITY_3: Ranged attack that spends Focus to deal damage to all targets with Hunter's Mark.
strings.HUNTER_MM_CORE_ABILITY_4: Ranged attack that hits your target and all nearby enemies, generating Focus per target hit.
strings.HUNTER_MM_CORE_ABILITY_5: Short-ranged attack with a cooldown that spends Focus to damage all targets in front of you and knock them away.
strings.HUNTER_MM_CORE_ABILITY_6: Passive. Auto Shots have a chance to cause your next Arcane Shot or Multi-Shot to apply Hunter's Mark, activating Marked Shot.
strings.HUNTER_PET_CUNNING_CORE_ABILITY_1: While your pet is active, you both move faster.
strings.HUNTER_PET_CUNNING_CORE_ABILITY_2: Ability that breaks you and your pet free of movement impairing effects.
strings.HUNTER_PET_CUNNING_CORE_ABILITY_3: Ability that causes your pet to share damage taken with the target.
strings.HUNTER_PET_CUNNING_CORE_ABILITY_4: Passive ability that increases your pet's movement speed.
strings.HUNTER_PET_CUNNING_CORE_ABILITY_5: Passive ability that increases all damage your pet deals.
strings.HUNTER_PET_CUNNING_CORE_ABILITY_6: Passive ability that causes your pet to deal more damage when at low health.
strings.HUNTER_PET_FEROCITY_CORE_ABILITY_1: While your pet is active, you both gain Leech.
strings.HUNTER_PET_FEROCITY_CORE_ABILITY_2: Ability that grants Haste to you and your allies for a short time.
strings.HUNTER_PET_FEROCITY_CORE_ABILITY_3: Passive ability that increases all damage your pet deals.
strings.HUNTER_PET_FEROCITY_CORE_ABILITY_4: Passive ability that increases your pet's attack speed, critical strike chance, and ability damage.
strings.HUNTER_PET_TENACITY_CORE_ABILITY_1: While your pet is active, you both gain increased maximum health.

strings.HUNTER_PET_TENACITY_CORE_ABILITY_4: Passive ability that decreases all damage your pet takes and increases healing your pet receives.
strings.HUNTER_PET_TENACITY_CORE_ABILITY_5: Passive ability that increases all damage your pet deals.
strings.HUNTER_PET_TENACITY_CORE_ABILITY_6: Passive ability that increases your pet's health.
strings.HUNTER_SV_CORE_ABILITY_1: A vicious slash that spends Focus to inflict heavy damage on your target.
strings.HUNTER_SV_CORE_ABILITY_2: Give the command to kill, causing your pet to savagely deal damage to the enemy and generate Focus.
strings.HUNTER_SV_CORE_ABILITY_3: Hurl a wildfire bomb at the target, dousing it in volatile flames that deal damage to all nearby enemies.
strings.HUNTER_SV_CORE_ABILITY_4: Fire a poison-tipped arrow at an enemy, dealing damage over time.
strings.HUNTER_SV_CORE_ABILITY_5: Hurl a Harpoon at an emeny, rooting them in place while you quickly pull yourself towards them.
strings.HUNTER_SV_CORE_ABILITY_6: Empowers your raptor strike to be cast from range, launching spectral eagles at your target.

strings.MAGE_ARCANE_CORE_ABILITY_1: Expensive ranged attack that generates an Arcane Charge. Damage and mana cost increased by Arcane Charges.
strings.MAGE_ARCANE_CORE_ABILITY_2: Free ranged attack that generates an Arcane Charge and is sometimes activated by your other spells. Damage increased by Arcane Charges.
strings.MAGE_ARCANE_CORE_ABILITY_3: Inexpensive ranged attack that consumes all Arcane Charges. Damage and number of targets hit increased by Arcane Charges.
strings.MAGE_ARCANE_CORE_ABILITY_4: Explosion centered on your location that generates an Arcane Charge. Damage and mana cost increased by Arcane Charges.
strings.MAGE_ARCANE_CORE_ABILITY_5: Channeled spell with a long cooldown that causes you to rapidly regenerate mana.
strings.MAGE_ARCANE_CORE_ABILITY_6: Spell with a long cooldown that causes your spells to deal more damage and cost less mana.
strings.MAGE_FIRE_CORE_ABILITY_2: Strong ranged attack with a long cast time.

strings.MAGE_FIRE_CORE_ABILITY_4: Ranged attack with a short cooldown that always deals a critical strike.
strings.MAGE_FIRE_CORE_ABILITY_5: Spell with a long cooldown that causes all your spells to deal critical strikes for a short time.
strings.MAGE_FIRE_CORE_ABILITY_6: Weaker ranged attack that can be cast while moving.
strings.MAGE_FROST_CORE_ABILITY_1: Primary ranged attack that also reduces the victim's movement speed.
strings.MAGE_FROST_CORE_ABILITY_2: Causes a Water Elemental to follow you and assist you in combat.
strings.MAGE_FROST_CORE_ABILITY_3: Instant ranged attack that deals strong damage if the target is frozen.
strings.MAGE_FROST_CORE_ABILITY_4: Passive. Frostbolt sometimes causes your next spell to treat the target as if it were frozen.
strings.MAGE_FROST_CORE_ABILITY_5: Strong attack that also reduces the victim's movement speed.
strings.MAGE_FROST_CORE_ABILITY_6: Passive. Frostbolt sometimes causes Flurry to become instant cast.

strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_AIC_TOOLTIP: Exclusive to MacOS X. This codec is the fastest to compress.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_CANCEL_CONFIRMATION: Do you really want to cancel this movie? This will delete the uncompressed part of the movie. If you are currently recording, you will lose the entire movie.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_COMPRESSING_CANCEL_NEWBI: This will finish the compression early. You will lose the part that is still not compressed. The part that is currently compressed will be saved on your hard drive.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_COMPRESS_TOOLTIP: This will search for uncompressed movies and ask you if you want to compress, delete or ignore them.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_DATA_RATE_TOOLTIP: This is how much data needs to be written to your hard drive every second. If the game becomes very choppy while recording then it might be that the data rate is too high for your hard drive. The game will stop recording if it cannot write the data fast enough.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_DV_TOOLTIP: DV is the primary codec for most camcorders and iMovie.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_ENABLE_COMPRESSION_TOOLT: If this is checked, the movie will be compressed when you stop recording. Otherwise, you will need to use the compress button to finish processing the movies.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_ENABLE_CURSOR_TOOLTIP: If this is checked, you will see the cursor in the movie. Regardless of this setting, you will see the cursor while playing.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_ENABLE_GUI_TOOLTIP: If this is checked, you will see the user interface in the movie. Regardless of this setting, you will see the user interface while playing.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_ENABLE_ICON_TOOLTIP: If this is checked, you will see a movie camera icon appear on the minimap frame while recording. If the user interface is recorded, this will also appear in the movie.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_ENABLE_RECOVER_TOOLTIP: If this is checked, the game will offer the choice of compressing, ignoring, or deleting any pending movies when you log in.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_ENABLE_SOUND_TOOLTIP: If this is checked, sound will be recorded in the movie.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_FRAMERATE_TOOLTIP: Changes the framerate of the movie. If you choose a fixed framerate, the game framerate will be capped to this while recording. Reduce to increase performance.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_GUI_OFF: Recording of the user interface is off.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_GUI_ON: Recording of the user interface is on.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_H264_TOOLTIP: This codec is supported natively by Apple devices like the iPod, iPhone and AppleTV. This codec has the best ratio quality/size but it is also the slowest to compress.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_MJPEG_TOOLTIP: This codec is faster to compress than H.264 but it will generate a bigger file.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_MPEG4_TOOLTIP: MPEG-4 is supported by many digital cameras and iMovie.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_QUALITY_TOOLTIP: Controls the movie quality. This will affect the final compression. Increasing the quality will also increase the amount of disk space used by the movie and the compression speed.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_RESOLUTION_TOOLTIP: Changes the resolution of the movie. You can record a longer movie if the resolution is smaller.
strings.MOVIE_RECORDING_TIME_TOOLTIP: This is how long you can record a movie before you run out of disk space. The game will stop recording after that time.

strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ABANDONQUEST: Abandons the selected quest, removing it from the Quest Log. Any quest that you abandon can be accepted again at some later date. There is no penalty for abandoning a quest.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ACHIEVEMENT: View information about your achievements and statistics.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ADDFRIEND: Adds a player to your friends list. You will be notified whenever a friend logs on or off. Other players do not know whether they are on your friends list.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ADDMEMBER: Adds a new player to the guild.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ADDTEAMMEMBER: Adds a new player to the team.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ALLIANCE: A proud member of the Alliance, opposed to members of the Horde (Orcs, Trolls, Tauren, Undead, Blood Elves, and Goblins).
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_AUTO_JOIN_VOICE:
Allows the automatic joining of
voice chat when not already
in another voice chat session.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_BATTLEFIELDMINIMAP_OPTION: Right-click to get a list of customizable options for this window. Left-click and drag to move the window.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_BATTLEFIELD_GROUP_JOIN: If you are the leader of a group, this button will add your current group to the battleground queue. Your group will be guaranteed to get into the same battleground instance at the same time.  Any group member added after you click this button or a group member in a queue for another battleground will not be guaranteed entrance to the same battleground.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHANNELPULLOUT_OPTIONS: Right-click to get a list of customizable options for this window. Left-click and drag to move the window.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHANNELTAB: Allows you to view or modify your text and voice chat channels.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHARACTER: Information about your character, including equipment, combat statistics, and reputation.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHATMENU: Commands used for communicating with others. With the Chat menu, you can talk to people standing nearby, send a private message to one person, chat with party members, wave at a friend, or create a macro.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHATOPTIONS: Right-click to get a list of customizable options for this window. Left-click and drag to move the window.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHAT_OVERFLOW: Not all chat tabs can be displayed. Left-click to see all chat tabs.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_DEMOTE: Demotes the selected player one rank lower.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_DISHONORABLE_KILLS: Each time you assist in killing a civilian in PvP that is too low of a level to give you experience (a gray level number), you will get a dishonorable kill.   Each dishonorable kill you get immediately reduces your overall ranking slightly, and each additional dishonorable kill you get during a single day has a larger effect than the last one.   Dishonorable kills are directly applied to your ranking.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_DISPLAY_CHANNEL_PULLOUT: Click and drag to display a roster window that lists players with voice chat enabled in this channel.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_DOWNLOAD_PERCENT: Indicates the percentage of the game that is downloaded
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ENCHANTSLOT: Drop an item into this slot to permit other players to unlock a container, or enchant or poison an item. An item placed in this slot will not be traded; rather, it will simply return to its owner's inventory.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ENCOUNTER_JOURNAL: View information about Cataclysm dungeon and raid bosses, including their abilities and treasure.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ENTER_BATTLEGROUND: Join the queue to enter this battleground when space becomes available.  This will result in a longer wait than selecting "First Available".
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_EQUIPMENT_MANAGER: Use the Equipment Manager to save Equipment Sets and switch back and forth between them quickly later.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_EQUIPMENT_MANAGER_IGNORE_: Prevents this inventory slot from being saved in the current Equipment Set.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_EQUIPMENT_MANAGER_PLACE_I: Take off this piece of equipment and put it in your bags.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_EQUIPMENT_MANAGER_UNIGNOR: Stops preventing this inventory slot from being saved in the current Equipment Set.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_FIRST_AVAILABLE: Join the queue to enter the first available battleground. If you select "First Available" and another party member enters a "First Available" battleground, then your preference will be changed to that battleground.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_FRAMERATE: Indicates how smoothly the game animates. Low framerate can be improved by changing your video options.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_FRIENDSTAB: Allows you to manage a list of players you enjoy playing with. You receive notifications of friends logging on or off.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GROUPINVITE: Invites the selected player to join a group.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDCONTROL: Allows you to customize the names of each rank in your guild, along with its privileges.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDGROUPINVITE: Invites the selected guild member to join a group.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDPUBLICNOTE: Click to view your public note. This is information that other players will see about you in the guild UI. If you click on the note itself, you will be able to edit it.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDREMOVE: Removes the selected player from the guild.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDTAB: Allows you to view information about your guild, and players in it. If you are an officer, you can also manage your guild from this tab.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILD_INFORMATION: Click to see additional information about your guild. If you are an officer or the guild leader, you can put information here for your guild members to read.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILD_MEMBER_OPTIONS: Right-click a guild member for more options.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HEALTHBAR: The amount of health you currently have. If your health reaches zero, you will die. Health automatically regenerates when you are out of combat.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HELP: Access the Online Knowledge Base or speak to a Game Master (GM) about a problem you are having.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONORABLE_KILLS: Each time you or a group you are part of does damage to an enemy player in PvP that is subsequently killed you gain an honorable kill.   You only get an honorable kill if the target’s difficulty is green or better (the target would give you experience if it were a monster).    Only enemy players give honorable kills.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONOR_CONTRIBUTION_POINTS: Honor is what you gain by making honorable kills in PvP combat.   How much honor you gain per kill is determined by how much damage you (or your group) did to the player that was killed, with more damage done equaling more honor.   This honor gain is split amongst the members of your group or raid group.   Also you will gain less honor for killing the same player over and over again in a short period of time, so after a few kills of the same player you will get little or no honor from killing them.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONOR_STANDING: Standing is how you are doing compared to all other players on your side (Horde or Alliance).   If your standing is 150, then there were 149 players who gained more honor than you did during that time period. You must get at least 25 Honorable Kills in a week in order to be eligible to gain Standing and Rank.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HORDE: A proud member of the Horde, opposed to members of the Alliance (Night Elves, Dwarves, Humans, Gnomes, Draenei, and Worgen).
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_IGNOREPLAYER: Adds a player to your ignore list. You will no longer see messages or other text from players on your ignore list, nor will these players be able to communicate with you in any other way.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_IGNORETAB: Allows you to modify the list of players whom you are currently ignoring.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_LATENCY: The time it takes to talk with the game server. Consistently high (red) latencies may indicate a problem with your Internet connection.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_LFGPARENT: A tool to find a group to complete a dungeon.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_LFMTAB: Click here to look for members to add to your existing group.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_LOOKINGFORGUILDTAB: Allows you to find a guild.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MAINMENU: Modify your settings, change your hotkeys or exit the game.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR0: The amount of mana you currently have. Players require mana in order to cast spells. Mana automatically regenerates if you have not cast a spell in the past five seconds.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR1: Warriors (and Druids in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form) require Rage in order to use their abilities.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR2: Hunters require focus to use their abilities.  Focus generates while standing still.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR3: Rogues (and Druids in Cat Form) require Energy in order to use their abilities.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR4: The amount of happiness your pet currently has. Content pets inflict normal damage on their enemies, whereas Happy pets inflict enhanced damage, and unhappy pets inflict reduced damage. Happiness goes down when your pet dies or as it grows hungry, while feeding your pet will increase its happiness.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MEMORY: How much memory your AddOns are using. You can get to the addon management page from the character select screen.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MOUNTS_AND_PETS: View all the mounts and pets you have. Also allows you to manage your pets' abilities if you are a Pet Trainer.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MUTEPLAYER: Adds a player to your mute list. You will no longer hear voice chat from players on your mute list.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PARTYOPTIONS: If you belong to a party, you can right-click your portrait to bring up the Party Options menu. This menu will allow you to quit the party or see what looting rules the party is using. A party leader can add or remove party members, as well as change the party's looting rules.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PLAYEROPTIONS: Right-click to bring up special commands for interacting with another player. You can inspect their equipment, issue a party invite, initiate a trade, or challenge a player to a duel. A group leader can promote or remove that player from the group.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PROMOTE: Promotes the selected player one rank higher.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PROTOCOLS: The protocol versions the game has chosen to connect to the servers. IPv6 is the latest technology available, but might cause issues as it isn't widely supported yet.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PVP: View information about your honor and your arena team.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PVPFFA: You can now attack and be attacked by any player in the game.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_QUESTLOG: A list of all the active quests you currently have. You can have up to 25 active quests at one time.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RAF_SUMMON_LINKED: Click here to summon a linked party member.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RAIDTAB: Allows you to view or modify your raid group. Raid groups are groups of more than 5 people used to defeat very difficult challenges at high levels.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RAID_BROWSER: Allows you to view a list of other players looking to perform particular activities. Also allows you to control your appearance on that list.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RAID_FINDER: A tool to find a group to complete a raid.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RANK: Rank is the final result of all the honor system calculations.  Based upon a comparison between your standing for the week versus your current rank, your rank may either rise, fall, or stay the same.  Higher level players rise more quickly in rank (and fall more slowly) than lower level players.  In addition, rank increases more quickly at low ranks than at high ranks.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RANK_POSITION: Your position within the rank. This bar will tell you how close you are to attaining the next rank or falling to the previous rank. This will only be updated each week when ranking is updated.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_REMOVEFRIEND: Removes the selected player from your friends list.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_REMOVEPLAYER: Removes the selected player from your ignore list.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SENDMESSAGE: Sends a private message to the selected player.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SHAREQUEST: Shares the selected quest with any party members who are eligible for the quest. Certain quests, such as those granted by items, cannot be shared.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SOCIAL: Information about other people in the game. You can use the Social window to manage your friends list and ignore list, as well as see who is online.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SPELLBOOK: To prepare a spell or ability for use, open the Spellbook & Abilities window, left-click the spell or ability and drag it down to your action bar.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_STOPIGNORE: Removes the selected player from your ignore list.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_TALENTS: The array of talents available to enhance and specialize your character.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_TRACKQUEST: Add or remove the selected quest from your quest watch list. You can click on a quest in your quest watch list to see the details of that quest.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_DUEL: Challenges the selected player to a duel. The first player to reach zero hit points loses the duel.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_FOLLOW: Causes you to begin following the selected player. You will automatically continue to follow the player until this auto follow mode is disrupted.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_FREE_FOR_ALL: Under free-for-all rules, all group members may loot a monster that they help the group to kill. Money is automatically divided between group members.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_GROUP_LOOT: Under group loot rules, players take turns looting just like in round-robin with the exception that all group members will be eligible to roll for items over the loot threshold.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_INSPECT: Inspects any armor and weapons that the selected player has equipped.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_INVITE: Invites the selected player to join a group.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_LEAVE_PARTY: Removes the player from their current party.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_LOOT_THRESHOLD: Items of this quality or higher will be able to be rolled on by the group when looted from a monster.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_MASTER_LOOTER: Under master-looter rules, the group leader is the only group member allowed to loot items at or above the threshold. Items below threshold and money are distributed via the round robin rules.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_NEED_BEFORE_GREED: Under need-before-greed rules, loot is distributed round-robin style.  Any items over the loot threshold can only be rolled on by group members that can use the item.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_OPT_OUT_LOOT: If enabled, you will only be able to receive loot by looting quest items, looting items that everyone passes on, or being given loot by the master looter.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PET_ABANDON: Releases your pet, letting it return to the wild. Once you release a pet, you can never regain its companionship.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PET_PAPERDOLL: Information about your pet, including its combat statistics, spell resistances, and diet.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PET_RENAME: Gives your pet a new name that you specify. A pet can only be renamed once.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PROMOTE: Surrenders your leadership of the group, naming the selected player to succeed you.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_ROUND_ROBIN: Under round-robin rules, group members take turns looting the monsters that they help the group to kill. Money is automatically divided between group members.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_TRADE: Initiates a trade with the selected player.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_UNINVITE: Removes the selected player from the group.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_VOTE_TO_KICK: Starts a vote to remove the selected player from the group.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNMUTE: Removes the selected player from your mute list.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_VIEWGUILD: View all the guild members that have this recipe.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_VOICE_CHAT_SELECTOR: This menu allows you to select the Voice Chat channel you would like to listen and speak in.  Right click to see a list of available voice chat channels.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_WHOTAB: Allows you to locate other players in the world.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_WORLDMAP: As you explore a zone, more areas of interest will become visible on the world map. You can use left-click to zoom in, or right-click to zoom out.
strings.NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_XPBAR: The amount of experience (XP) you have earned. The color of the XP bar indicates your rest state: light blue for Rested, and purple for Normal. Rested players earn twice the experience they would normally gain from slaying a monster. Characters become less rested when they kill monsters, and more rested by spending time at or logging out at an inn or city.

strings.OPTION_STEREO_CONVERGENCE: Stereo convergence controls the depth of the point of convergence where no parallax occurs. Increase convergence to push objects further out of the screen. Too much convergence can be uncomfortable if your eyes are not adjusted to stereo.
strings.OPTION_STEREO_SEPARATION: Stereo separation refers to the difference in horizontal position between the right and left images. The greater the stereo separation, the greater the stereo effect. Too much separation can be uncomfortable if your eyes are not adjusted to stereo.
strings.OPTION_TARGETFPS: Framerate you ideally want to play at. If your framerate is below this number, dynamic systems will reduce graphics quality to attempt to hit this framerate.
strings.OPTION_TARGETFPS_CHECK: Enable this option to dynamically reduce graphics quality if you fall below a specific framerate.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ACCESSIBILITY_FONT_SIZE: Adjust the display size of text used throughout the game
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ACTION_BUTTON_USE_KEY_DOW: Action button keybinds will respond on key down, rather than on key up.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ACTION_TARGETING: A targeting system that dynamically targets enemies based on where you're looking. Works alongside the standard targeting system.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ADJUST_COLORBLIND_STRENGT: Adjusts the strength of the selected colorblind filter.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ADVANCED_COMBAT_LOGGING: Enables extra logging data when writing the combat log to a text file. This may cause additional network lag when using the "combatlog" chat command.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ADVANCED_MSAA: Sets the Multisample Anti-Aliasing mode. Both the number of color and depth samples can be specified.

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ADV_FLY_PITCH_CONTROL:
Helps to address hand motor function while skyriding.

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPATIBILITY_SETTINGS: Compatibility settings are offered to help diagnose and work around various crashes, graphical bugs and performance issues. In most cases disabling these features will decrease performance, introduce hitching and/or decrease visual quality. They are only intended to be disabled if you are having specific issues.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPAT_SETTING_ADV_WORK_S: Allows more complex code paths for submitting work to the GPU. Disabling this may cause less consistent or lower framerate but could help avoid some kinds of crashes for certain hardware, driver and OS combinations.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPAT_SETTING_CMDLIST_MU: Allows the game to use multiple CPU threads to render the game. Disabling this will likely greatly reduce framerate, but could work around crashes or visual bugs in some cases.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPAT_SETTING_DEVICE_MUL: Allows asynchronously creating GPU resources such as textures and shaders. Disabling this will likely introduce hitching but could help work around crashes or visual issues on very old drivers or hardware.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPAT_SETTING_FRAME_OVER: Allows the CPU to work on 2 frames at once. Disabling this may cause less consistent or lower framerate but could help avoid some kinds of crashes for certain hardware, driver and OS combinations.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPAT_SETTING_OPTIONAL_G: Allows the use of newer GPU features. When disabled, the game will act as if the GPU only supports the minimum required features. Various graphical features will be disabled and the visual quality of the game will likely be reduced. This may help work around driver bugs or other issues with newer GPU features.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMPUTE_EFFECTS: Controls the quality of Compute-based effects such as Volumetric Fog and some particle effects. Compute-based effects may be more expensive for older graphics cards.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_CONSOLIDATE_BUFFS: Filters certain buffs into a buff consolidation box. Short term buffs are displayed in the box. Very long term buffs are displayed in the box until they are about to expire.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_CONTRAST: Controls the Contrast of the game.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_COUNTDOWN_FOR_COOLDOWNS: Check this to show a number countdown for action button cooldowns.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_DEATH_EFFECT: Uncheck to disable glowing effect while in ghost form. Disabling this can sometimes improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_DECOR_LIGHT_RADIUS_INDICA: Enables Light Radius Indicators to show when placing Decor
The Indicator is always visible while moving a light.

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_DEPTH_EFFECTS: Controls the rendering of depth-based particle effects.  Decreasing this may improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_DESKTOP_GAMMA: Use the same gamma settings as your desktop.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_DISABLE_AOE_LOOTING_DEFAU: When this setting is disabled you will only loot from the corpse you clicked on, not all the lootable corpses around you. Uncheck this to loot from all in-range lootable corpses.

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_DISABLE_CHAT_ACCOUNT_MUTE:

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_BGSOUND: Enable to allow sounds to play even when World of Warcraft is in the background.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_EMOTE_SOUNDS: Toggles emote sounds on and off.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_ERROR_SPEECH: Enables speech from errors (e.g. "Target out of range").
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_GAMEPAD_UI: When this is true, the gamepad UI will be enabled
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_HARDWARE: Enables the use of hardware for 3D sound management. This may alter your sound performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_INTERACT: Allows you to interact with NPCs and objects using a keypress
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_MOUSEOVER_CAST: Once enabled, mousing over a unit frame and casting a spell using a keyboard hotkey will cast it directly on that unit without having it targeted.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_MOUSEOVER_CAST_KEY: When held this key will enable mouseover casting.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_MUSIC_LOOPING: Enable to continuously play background music.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_PET_BATTLE_MUSIC: Enable special music during pet battles.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_PET_SOUNDS: Toggles pet idle and aggro sounds on and off.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_PINGS: Toggles the ping system on and off
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_PING_SOUNDS: Toggles ping sounds on and off
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_QUEST_TEXT_CONTRAS: Makes quest text easier to read
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_REMOTE_TEXT_TO_SPE: Enables typing into the voice chat window to speak to other players using the selected voice
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_REVERB: Enables reverb sound effects. This will affect performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SCREEN_NARRATOR: Enable to read UI elements aloud on hover. Available on the login, realm selection, and character creation screens
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SOFTWARE_HRTF: Simulates real world audio environment by reducing audio frequency over distance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SOUNDFX: Enables or disables game sound effects.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SOUND_AT_CHARACTER: Listen to sound from the character's point of view rather than the camera.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SPEECH_TO_TEXT_TRA: Allows enabling transcription on a voice channel in order to see written text based on the words spoken by other players
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_TEXT_TO_SPEECH: Reads chat text out loud using the voice text to speech system based on the selected options
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_VOICECHAT: Voice Chat is not monitored by Blizzard Entertainment, and your gameplay experience may change based on interaction with other players.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENVIRONMENT_DETAIL: Controls how far you can see objects. Decrease to improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FARCLIP: View distance controls how far you can see. Larger view distances require more memory and a faster processor.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FIX_LAG: Enabling this reduces user interface lag, but may drastically reduce frame rates.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FLASH_LOW_HEALTH_WARNING: Do not flash the screen red when you are low on health.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOCUS_CAST_ALT_KEY: Use the "ALT" key to cast targeted spells on your Focus Target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOCUS_CAST_CTRL_KEY: Use the "CTRL" key to cast targeted spells on your Focus Target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOCUS_CAST_SHIFT_KEY: Use the "SHIFT" key to cast targeted spells on your Focus Target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOCUS_GLOW_COLOR: Change the color of the glow around focused frames.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOCUS_OPACITY: Change the glow opacity, set to 0 to make the glow disappear.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOLLOW_TERRAIN: Automatically change the camera angle based on the terrain. If your character climbs a slope, the camera will rotate upwards; if you descend, it will rotate downwards.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FULL_SCREEN_GLOW: Enables a full screen effect that softens edges and lighting. Disabling this can sometimes improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_FULL_SIZE_FOCUS_FRAME: Increases the size of the Focus Frame to that of the Target Frame.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEFIELD_DESELECT: Checking this will prevent the deselection of targets by clicking on the gamefield.  Targets can only be cleared by pressing escape or clicking another target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_BACK_PEDAL_THRESH: The stick magnitude must be greater than or equal to this value to face the direction of movement rather than back pedaling. A value of 0 is disabled.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_FACE_MOVEMENT_GLI: Always face the stick movement direction while gliding and not in combat.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_FACE_MOVEMENT_MOU: Always face the stick movement direction while on a mount, not in combat, and not gliding.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_FACE_MOVEMENT_SWI: Always face the stick movement direction while swimming and not in combat.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_FOLLOW_CAMERA: Camera follows the player while remaining centered behind them.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_FOLLOW_CAMERA_PIT: Offset in degrees from character center that the follower camera will maintain.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_MOVEMENT_FACE_ANG: Stick angle past the set value will make the player face the stick movement; otherwise, the player strafes while facing the camera direction. Angle of 0 makes the player always face the stick movement direction. Angle of 180 makes the player always face the camera direction. Only applies when not in combat.

Angle of 0 makes the player always face the stick movement direction. Angle of 180 makes the player always face the camera direction. Only applies when in combat.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_RUN_THRESHOLD: The stick magnitude must be greater than this value to run.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_SHOW_EMPTY_ACTION: Show all gamepad action bars even if they have no abilities bound
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPAD_SHOW_LEGEND: Always show the gamepad action list on screen
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEPLAY_SFX_VOLUME: Adjusts the gameplay sound effects volume
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMMA: Controls the Gamma of the game.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GRAPHICS_CARD: Select which graphics card you want to use.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GROUND_CLUTTER: Controls the density and the distance at which ground clutter items, like grass and foliage, are placed. Decrease to improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GROUND_DENSITY: Controls the number of ground clutter items, like grass and foliage. Decrease to improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GROUND_RADIUS: Controls the draw distance of ground clutter items like grass and foliage. Decrease to improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_GUILDMEMBER_ALERT: Show a message when your guild members login and logout.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_HARDCORE_ANNOUNCE_DEATH_A: Never show a raid-style warning for any deaths
Only show raid-style warnings for guild member deaths
Show raid-style warnings for all deaths on the realm
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_HARDCORE_ANNOUNCE_DEATH_D: Only show guild deaths in chat
Announce all deaths on the realm
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_HARDWARE_CURSOR: Enable this option for a more responsive cursor unless you have cursor problems.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_HD_TEXTURES: Enables higher detail textures for characters, creatures, buildings, objects, terrain, and more.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_HEAD_BOB: Simulate head bobbing when in first-person perspective.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_HIDE_ADVENTURE_JOURNAL_AL: Hide alerts for new adventure opportunities
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_HIDE_OUTDOOR_WORLD_STATE: Checking this will hide the interface for tracking zone wide objectives.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_HIDE_PARTY_INTERFACE: Click this to hide your party's portraits and health bars.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_INTERACT_ICONS: Controls which icons appear above NPCs and objects when the Interact Key feature is enabled
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_INTERACT_ON_LEFT_CLICK: Interact with objects and friendly non-player characters using left or right click.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_INVERT_GAMEPAD_PITCH: Invert the direction the gamepad's right stick rotates the camera vertically.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_INVERT_GAMEPAD_YAW: Invert the direction the gamepad's right stick rotates the camera horizontally.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_INVERT_MOUSE: Invert the way that the mouse affects camera pitch.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_KEEP_GROUPS_TOGETHER: Display separate frames for each group in your raid.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LEGACY_LIQUID_DETAIL: Controls the rendering quality of older liquids.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LIGHTING_MODE: Controls the detail level of secondary lighting effects
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LIGHTING_QUALITY: Controls both the method and quality of lighting.  Decreasing this may improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LIQUID_DETAIL: Controls the rendering quality of liquid. Decreasing this may improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOCALE: Select which language you would like to play in.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOCK_ACTIONBAR: Prevents the user from picking up/dragging spells on the action bar. This function can be bound to a function key in the keybindings interface.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOCK_CURSOR: Prevent the cursor from leaving the game window
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOG_PERIODIC_EFFECTS: Display damage caused by periodic effects such as Rend and Shadow Word: Pain.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LONG_RANGE_NAMEPLATE: Turning this option on will increase the range at which name plates appear.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOOT_KEY_TEXT: Key to use to single loot a corpse
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOOT_UNDER_MOUSE: When checked the loot window will open up under the current mouse location.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOSS_OF_CONTROL: Shows an alert in the middle of the screen when you lose control of your character.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOW_LATENCY_MODE: Allows the game to use various techniques to reduce input latency
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MAP_FADE: Fade out the map when you start moving.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MAP_QUEST_DIFFICULTY: Color quest titles by difficulty when displayed with the World Map.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MAP_TRACK_QUEST: Add or remove the selected quest from your quest watch list.|nYou can also shift click on a quest or its icon.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MAX_FOLLOW_DIST: Adjust the maximum distance the camera will follow behind you.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MINIMUM_CHARACTER_NAME_SI: Adjusts the minimum size of character names.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOTION_SICKNESS_CHECKBOX: Enabling the Motion Sickness setting will reduce camera movement and keep your character centered.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOTION_SICKNESS_DRAGONRID:
Helps to address motion sickness while skyriding.

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSEOVER_CAST_ALT_KEY: Use the "ALT" key to cast targeted spells on your Mouseover Target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSEOVER_CAST_CTRL_KEY: Use the "CTRL" key to cast targeted spells on your Mouseover Target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSEOVER_CAST_SHIFT_KEY: Use the "SHIFT" key to cast targeted spells on your Mouseover Target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSE_LOOK_SPEED: Adjust the speed at which you turn the camera when using mouse look.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY: Adjust the speed at which the mouse cursor moves.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSE_SPEED: Enables setting a custom mouse sensitivity to override the setting from the operating system.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOVE_PAD: The Move Pad is a mouse click-able UI frame for movement and jump.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MULTISAMPLE_ALPHA_TEST: Evaluates alpha-test operation at sample frequency rather than pixel frequency when MSAA is enabled.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_MULTISAMPLING: Increase multisampling to smooth out model edges. Increasing multisampling can severely reduce performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_NAMEPLATE_HIDE_HEALTH_AND: Hide the health and power bars under your character
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_NOTCH_MODE: Controls how notch overlap is handled
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_OBJECTIVES_IGNORE_CURSOR: Locks the Objectives frame and keeps it from being displayed on mouseover.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_OBJECT_NPC_OUTLINE: In addition to quest objectives, Selection Outlines can be turned on for mouseover and Target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_OBJECT_NPC_OUTLINE_NOT_AL: Outline Mode is disabled in the System Graphics options.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_OBJECT_NPC_OUTLINE_NOT_SU: Outline Mode is not supported by this computer's video hardware.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_OPTIMIZE_NETWORK_SPEED:
Enable this option to optimize network usage for speed in order to decrease lag.
This will increase your bandwidth usage, and may cause problems in some environments. Disabling this option may help resolve certain disconnection issues.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_OTHER_DECOR_LIGHT_RADIUS_: Controls how the Light Radius Indicator is displayed on non-selected Decor while decorating.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_OUTLINE_MODE: Controls whether the selection outline effect is allowed.  See the Interface Display panel for more options.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_OVERRIDE_SCREEN_FLASH: Changes the color of full screen flashes and fades to black.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PARTICLE_DENSITY: Controls the number of particles used in effects caused by spells, fires, etc. Decrease to improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PBR_LIQUID_DETAIL: Controls the rendering quality of new, Physically Based, liquids.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PET_NAMEPLATES: Toggles displaying of name plates on your pets, totems, and guardians.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PET_SPELL_DAMAGE: Show spell damage caused by your pet.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PHONG_SHADING: Enable this option for smooth lighting across characters.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PICKUP_ACTION_ALT_KEY: Use the "ALT" key to pick up/drag spells from locked action bars.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PICKUP_ACTION_CTRL_KEY: Use the "CTRL" key to pick up/drag spells from locked action bars.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PICKUP_ACTION_SHIFT_KEY: Use the "SHIFT" key to pick up/drag spells from locked action bars.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PING_MODE: Determines which mode is used to interact with the ping system.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PING_MODE_CLICK_DRAG: When pressing the ping keybind, click to contextually ping, or click and drag to trigger the ping radial menu.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PING_MODE_KEY_DOWN: Press and release the ping keybind to contextually ping, or press and hold to trigger the ping radial menu.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PING_TARGET: Determines what can be targeted by a ping.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PING_TARGET_ALL: Pings will hit both Environmental and Units in the world.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PING_TARGET_ENVIRONMENT: Pings will only hit environmental objects or locations in the world, ignoring all units.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PING_TARGET_KEYBIND: Set a keybind to toggle between "Show All" and "Environment" states in Options > Keybindings > Ping System.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PING_TARGET_UNITS: Pings will only hit units in the world, ignoring all environmental objects or locations.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PLAYER_DETAIL: Controls the resolution of player textures. Decreasing this may slightly improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PLAY_AGGRO_SOUNDS: Enable the playing of alert sounds when aggro advances to a higher level.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PRIMARY_MONITOR: Allows you to change the primary monitor used by the display.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PROFANITY_FILTER_WITH_WAR:
Enable mature language filtering.

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PROJECTED_TEXTURES: Enables the projecting of textures to the environment. Disabling this may improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PUSHTOTALK_SOUND: Plays a small sound whenever you press your Push to Talk key.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_PVP_COMPACT_UNIT_FRAME_PR: Display only healer power bars. Non-healer power bars will be hidden.
Display the summoned pets of your pvp opponents.
Display the power bars of pvp opponents
Determines what type of health text to show in pvp frames.
Display remaining health as a number
Display a number only when health is lost
