Display class specific colors. If unchecked, default colors will be used.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_RAID_CHAT_BUBBLES: Shows chat bubbles for raid chat.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_RAID_USE_CLASS_COLORS: Colors the health bars of raid members with the relevant class color.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_REDUCED_LAG_TOLERANCE: Allows you to reduce the time before a Global Cooldown has finished during which you may queue up a spell. You may want to set this to approximate your latency.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_REFRESH_RATE: Refers to the number of times the image is drawn to the monitor.  Some players may see a flicker if the refresh rate is too low.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_REMOVE_CHAT_DELAY: Check to show chat windows immediately upon mouseover.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_RENDER_SCALE: Changes the resolution for rendering the 3D World. Lowering the render scale below 100% reduces the GPU workload and can greatly improve frame rate in some cases. Render scale above 100% is for supersampled anti-aliasing (SSAA). SSAA is very expensive for the GPU and only recommended if you are unsatisfied with the other anti-aliasing options offered.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_REPLACE_MY_PLAYER_PORTRAI: Replace your player unit frame portrait with your class icon
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_REPLACE_OTHER_PLAYER_PORT: Replace other player unit frame portraits with class icons
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_RESAMPLE_QUALITY: When using a Render Scale that is not 100%, this adjusts the quality of the upscale/downscale. Note: Point and FidelityFX Super Resolution are only used for upscaling. If Render Scale is above 100%, Bicubic is used for SSAA instead.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_RESET_CHAT_POSITION: Reset chat window positions back to their default.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_RESOLUTION: Sets the resolution of the game window.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_RESTRICT_CALENDAR_INVITES: Only allow calendar invites from friends or guild members.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_REVERSE_CLEAN_UP_BAGS: If checked, Clean Up Bags will move items to your rightmost bags.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_REVERSE_NEW_LOOT: If checked, new items will appear in your leftmost bag.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_ROTATE_MINIMAP: Check this to rotate the entire minimap instead of the player arrow.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_RT_SHADOW_QUALITY: Improves shadow quality with ray tracing, which produces shadows with more natural softness, greatly increased precision, and from additional light sources.|n|nThis feature requires:|nA hardware ray tracing capable graphics card|nWindows 10 May 2020 Update (version 2004)|nUp to date graphics drivers|nDirectX 12
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCREEN_NARRATOR_SPEECH_RA: Adjust the rate of speech for the screen narrator
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCREEN_NARRATOR_SPEECH_VO: Adjust the volume of the screen narrator
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCREEN_NARRATOR_VOICE: Choose the style of voice used by the screen narrator
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCROLL_ARC: Scrolls the text in arcs away from the player.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCROLL_DOWN: Scrolls combat text towards the bottom of the screen.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCROLL_UP: Scrolls combat text towards the top of the screen.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SECURE_ABILITY_TOGGLE: When selected you will be protected from toggling your abilities off if accidently hitting the button more than once in a short period of time.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SELECTED_DECOR_LIGHT_RADI: Controls how the Light Radius Indicator is displayed on selected Decor while decorating.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SELF_HIGHLIGHT: Add a highlight to make it easier to see your character.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SELF_HIGHLIGHT_IN_BG_COMB: Only highlight your character when in combat.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SELF_HIGHLIGHT_IN_RAID_CO: Only highlight your character when in combat.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHADOW_QUALITY: Controls both the method and quality of shadows. Decreasing this may greatly improve performance.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHARPNESS: Adjusts the strength of the FidelityFX Super Resolution sharpness effect. 0 is full strength.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_ACCOUNT_ACHIEVEMENTS: Turning this option on will only display your character achievements when people inspect you or use the Blizzard website.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_ALL_ENEMY_DEBUFFS: Show all debuffs on enemy targets instead of just those deemed relevant to you.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_APPEARANCE_TOASTS: Enabling this option will display toasts when appearances are unlocked.

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_ARENA_ENEMY_PETS: Show the portraits of the pets belonging to the enemy arena team.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_BATTLENET_TOASTS: Enable this to have Blizzard system messages appear in a popup window.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_BORDERS: Display border artwork around the Raid Frames.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_BUFF_DURATION: Toggle text counters for buff durations on and off.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_CASTABLE_BUFFS: Show only buffs you can cast on friendly targets.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_CASTABLE_DEBUFFS: Show only the debuffs you applied on enemy targets.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_CHAT_ICONS: Controls whether or not icon links in auto-joined chat channels (such as Trade) are displayed as icons.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_CLASS_COLOR_IN_V_KEY: Toggles class colors in the background of Nameplate health bar for enemy players.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_CLOAK: Uncheck this box to hide your character's cloak.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_CLOCK: Displays the clock button on the minimap.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_COLLECTION_TOASTS: Enabling this option will display toasts when collection items are unlocked.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_COMBAT_HEALING: Display amount of healing you did to the target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_COMBAT_HEALING_ABSOR: Shows a message when you gain a shield.
Display amount of shield you added to the target.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_COMBAT_TEXT: Checking this will enable additional combat messages to appear in the playfield.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_DAMAGE: Display damage numbers over hostile creatures when damaged.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_DISPELLABLE_DEBUFFS: Show only debuffs you can dispel on friendly targets.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_FULLSCREEN_STATUS: Shows a screen edge flash when you have a fullscreen UI up and you are in combat.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_GUILD_NAMES: Always display player guild names in the game world.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_HD_MODELS: Check this to use higher definition character models.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_HELM: Uncheck this box to hide your character's helm.

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_ITEM_LEVEL: Display item level in the tooltip for certain items.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_ITEM_TOASTS: Enabling this option will display toasts when some items are received.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_LEARNED_RECIPE_TOAST: Enabling this option will display toasts when profession recipes are learned.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_LOOT_SPAM: Uncheck this to hide individual loot roll messages and only show the winner.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_LUA_ERRORS: Shows error messages related to UI functionality.
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_MULTIBAR1: Centered and attached above Action Bar 1 by default
strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_MULTIBAR2: Centered and attached above Action Bar 2 by default

strings.OPTION_TOOLTIP_VOICE_CHAT_SERVICE_DISCOR:
In-Game Voice (Discord)

Uses World of Warcraft's built-in voice chat powered by Discord when you are the group leader.

You can link your Discord account to inherit Discord keybind and volume settings (optional, under Social settings).

Other players do not require a Discord account to join.

strings.PHYSICAL_HARASSMENT_DESCRIPTION: If the sole purpose or intent of any action is to continually upset, aggravate, or otherwise annoy another player, that action may be considered physical harassment or "grief play".  Before reporting physical harassment, make sure that the situation that is being petitioned falls outside the realm of the PvP policy (www.worldofwarcraft.com/policy/pvp.shtml).

strings.PHYSICAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT2: Attacking a creep or NPC that another player has already engaged
strings.PHYSICAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT3: Continually attacking and/or killing an NPC
strings.PHYSICAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT4: "Spawn camping" ("claiming" a spawn point in order to repeatedly attack a creep)
strings.PHYSICAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT5: "Corpse camping" (waiting by a player's corpse to attack them as they resurrect)
strings.PHYSICAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT6: "Training" (leading enemies to another player to force combat)

strings.RACE_INFO_BLOODELF:
Long ago the majestic high elves created the splendid golden city of Quel'Thalas, built around a magical fount of energy known as the Sunwell. When the Lich King destroyed their capital in the Third War, the survivors turned to the Horde for help.

Now known as the blood elves, these refugees are all that remains of their glorious civilization. They strive to rebuild Quel'Thalas while struggling against a crippling addiction to the very magical energies that once built their empire.
strings.RACE_INFO_BLOODELF_FEMALE:
Long ago the majestic high elves created the splendid golden city of Quel'Thalas, built around a magical fount of energy known as the Sunwell. When the Lich King destroyed their capital in the Third War, the survivors turned to the Horde for help.

Now known as the blood elves, these refugees are all that remains of their glorious civilization. They strive to rebuild Quel'Thalas while struggling against a crippling addiction to the very magical energies that once built their empire.
strings.RACE_INFO_BLOODELF_SHORT: Long ago the majestic high elves created the splendid golden city of Quel'Thalas. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_DARKIRONDWARF: Known for their fiery tempers and fierce determination, the Dark Iron have a history of strife with the other dwarven clans--as well as their own kin. Queen-Regeant Moira seeks to unite her people and lead them in the fight to save Azeroth.
strings.RACE_INFO_DARKIRONDWARF_FEMALE: Known for their fiery tempers and fierce determination, the Dark Iron have a history of strife with the other dwarven clans--as well as their own kin. Queen-Regeant Moira seeks to unite her people and lead them in the fight to save Azeroth.
strings.RACE_INFO_DARKIRONDWARF_SHORT: Known for their fiery tempers and fierce determination, the Dark Iron have a history of strife. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_DRAENEI: Driven from their home world of Argus, the honorable draenei fled the Burning Legion for eons before finding a remote planet to settle on. They shared this world with the shamanistic orcs and named it Draenor. In time the Legion corrupted the orcs, who waged war and nearly exterminated the peaceful draenei. A lucky few fled to Azeroth, where they now seek allies in their battle against the Burning Legion.
strings.RACE_INFO_DRAENEI_FEMALE: Driven from their home world of Argus, the honorable draenei fled the Burning Legion for eons before finding a remote planet to settle on. They shared this world with the shamanistic orcs and named it Draenor. In time the Legion corrupted the orcs, who waged war and nearly exterminated the peaceful draenei. A lucky few fled to Azeroth, where they now seek allies in their battle against the Burning Legion.
strings.RACE_INFO_DRAENEI_SHORT: Driven from their home world of Argus, the honorable draenei fled the Burning Legion for eons. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_DWARF: In ages past, the dwarves cared only for riches taken from the earth's depths. Then records surfaced of a god-like race said to have given the dwarves life... and an enchanted birthright. Driven to learn more, the dwarves devoted themselves to the pursuit of lost artifacts and ancient knowledge. Today dwarven archaeologists are scattered throughout the globe.

strings.RACE_INFO_DWARF_SHORT: In ages past, the dwarves cared only for riches taken from the earth's depths. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_EARTHENDWARF: The earthen of Khaz Algar, newly freed of their edicts, venture forth into Azeroth. They bring with them boundless curiosity, and a wish to return all their experiences back to the archive.
strings.RACE_INFO_EARTHENDWARF_FEMALE: The earthen of Khaz Algar, newly freed of their edicts, venture forth into Azeroth. They bring with them boundless curiosity, and a wish to return all their experiences back to the archive.
strings.RACE_INFO_GNOME: Though small in stature, the clever gnomes of Khaz Modan have used their great intellect to secure a place in history. Their subterranean kingdom of Gnomeregan is a marvel of steam-driven technology, and their skill at both engineering and the arcane arts has been a tremendous benefit to the Alliance across numerous campaigns.
strings.RACE_INFO_GNOME_FEMALE: Though small in stature, the clever gnomes of Khaz Modan have used their great intellect to secure a place in history. Their subterranean kingdom of Gnomeregan is a marvel of steam-driven technology, and their skill at both engineering and the arcane arts has been a tremendous benefit to the Alliance across numerous campaigns.
strings.RACE_INFO_GNOME_SHORT: Though small in stature, the clever gnomes of Khaz Modan have used their great intellect. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_GOBLIN: Originally the slaves of jungle trolls on the Isle of Kezan, the goblin race was forced to mine Kaja'mite ore out of the Undermine, deep in the bowels of Mount Kajaro.  Unbeknownst to anyone at the time, the mineral had magical properties that caused the goblins to rapidly increase in both cunning and intelligence.  Tinkering their own powerful artifacts of engineering and alchemy in secret, the goblins overthrew their troll oppressors, taking over the island that they now call home.  Quickly rising to prominence as masters of mercantilism, goblins and their global trade conglomerates dominate all commerce across Azeroth.
strings.RACE_INFO_GOBLIN_SHORT: Originally the slaves of jungle trolls on the Isle of Kezan, the goblin race was forced to mine. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_HARRONIR: The Goddess Aln'hara was stolen from her cradle long before the haranir came to guard her lands. They kept the world unaware of its existence until the young prophet, Orweyna. was called to aid Azeroth's people, and exposed the savage, subterranean land of Harandar. Now some young haranir have taken up the hunt to find their goddess, witness all of her creations, and bring their unrestrained fury to all who threaten her.
strings.RACE_INFO_HARRONIR_FEMALE: The Goddess Aln'hara was stolen from her cradle long before the haranir came to guard her lands. They kept the world unaware of its existence until the young prophet, Orweyna. was called to aid Azeroth's people, and exposed the savage, subterranean land of Harandar. Now some young haranir have taken up the hunt to find their goddess, witness all of her creations, and bring their unrestrained fury to all who threaten her.
strings.RACE_INFO_HIGHMOUNTAINTAUREN: The tauren of Highmountain are devoted to the spirits of earth, river, and sky. After ages spent protecting their sacred mountain, they are now ready to venture out into the world beyond the Broken Isles.
strings.RACE_INFO_HIGHMOUNTAINTAUREN_FEMALE: The tauren of Highmountain are devoted to the spirits of earth, river, and sky. After ages spent protecting their sacred mountain, they are now ready to venture out into the world beyond the Broken Isles.
strings.RACE_INFO_HIGHMOUNTAINTAUREN_SHORT: The tauren of Highmountain are devoted to the spirits of earth, river, and sky. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_HUMAN: Humans are a young race, and thus highly versatile, mastering the arts of combat, craftsmanship, and magic with stunning efficiency. The humans’ valor and optimism have led them to build some of the world’s greatest kingdoms. In this troubled era, after generations of conflict, humanity seeks to rekindle its former glory and forge a shining new future.
strings.RACE_INFO_HUMAN_FEMALE: Humans are a young race, and thus highly versatile, mastering the arts of combat, craftsmanship, and magic with stunning efficiency. The humans’ valor and optimism have led them to build some of the world’s greatest kingdoms. In this troubled era, after generations of conflict, humanity seeks to rekindle its former glory and forge a shining new future.
strings.RACE_INFO_HUMAN_SHORT: Humans are a young race, and thus highly versatile, mastering the arts of combat. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_KULTIRAN: Kul Tiras was founded by fearless explorers who sailed uncharted waters in search of adventure. As a key member of the Alliance of Lordaeron, the Kul Tiran navy dominated the seas of Azeroth with its legendary fleet.
strings.RACE_INFO_KULTIRAN_FEMALE: Kul Tiras was founded by fearless explorers who sailed uncharted waters in search of adventure. As a key member of the Alliance of Lordaeron, the Kul Tiran navy dominated the seas of Azeroth with its legendary fleet.
strings.RACE_INFO_KULTIRAN_SHORT: Kul Tiras was founded by fearless explorers who sailed uncharted waters in search of adventure. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_LIGHTFORGEDDRAENEI: Fighting a long, bitter war against the Burning Legion, these draenei soldiers were infused with the Holy Light to become living weapons. Victorious at last, these Lightforged stand ready to defend Azeroth.
strings.RACE_INFO_LIGHTFORGEDDRAENEI_FEMALE: Fighting a long, bitter war against the Burning Legion, these draenei soldiers were infused with the Holy Light to become living weapons. Victorious at last, these Lightforged stand ready to defend Azeroth.
strings.RACE_INFO_LIGHTFORGEDDRAENEI_SHORT: Fighting a long, bitter war against the Burning Legion, these draenei soldiers were infused. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_MAGHARORC: The orc clans of Draenor never drank the demon blood that corrupted their distant kin. Proud and defiant, they stood united as one tribe--the Mag'har. With their unrelenting courage and fierce sense of honor, the Mag'har now fight to claim a new home on Azeroth.
strings.RACE_INFO_MAGHARORC_FEMALE: The orc clans of Draenor never drank the demon blood that corrupted their distant kin. Proud and defiant, they stood united as one tribe--the Mag'har. With their unrelenting courage and fierce sense of honor, the Mag'har now fight to claim a new home on Azeroth.
strings.RACE_INFO_MAGHARORC_SHORT: The orc clans of Draenor never drank the demon blood that corrupted their distant kin. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_MECHAGNOME: Though they once sought to mechanize themselves completely, the mechagnomes now seek a balance between flesh and steel. Emerging from years of isolation on Mechagon, they bring both ingenuity and aptitude to the Alliance.
strings.RACE_INFO_MECHAGNOME_FEMALE: Though they once sought to mechanize themselves completely, the mechagnomes now seek a balance between flesh and steel. Emerging from years of isolation on Mechagon, they bring both ingenuity and aptitude to the Alliance.
strings.RACE_INFO_MECHAGNOME_SHORT: Though they once sought to mechanize themselves completely, the mechagnomes now seek. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_NIGHTBORNE: The nightborne of Suramar spent millennia isolated behind an arcane barrier, slowly transformed by the magic of the Nightwell. These proud, noble elves now seek to reclaim their place in Azeroth.
strings.RACE_INFO_NIGHTBORNE_FEMALE: The nightborne of Suramar spent millennia isolated behind an arcane barrier, slowly transformed by the magic of the Nightwell. These proud, noble elves now seek to reclaim their place in Azeroth.
strings.RACE_INFO_NIGHTBORNE_SHORT: The nightborne of Suramar spent millennia isolated behind an arcane barrier, slowly transformed. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_NIGHTELF: Ten thousand years ago, the night elves founded a vast empire, but their reckless use of primal magic brought them to ruin. In grief, they withdrew to the forests and remained isolated there until the return of their ancient enemy, the Burning Legion. With no other choice, the night elves emerged at last from their seclusion to fight for their place in the new world.
strings.RACE_INFO_NIGHTELF_FEMALE: Ten thousand years ago, the night elves founded a vast empire, but their reckless use of primal magic brought them to ruin. In grief, they withdrew to the forests and remained isolated there until the return of their ancient enemy, the Burning Legion. With no other choice, the night elves emerged at last from their seclusion to fight for their place in the new world.
strings.RACE_INFO_NIGHTELF_SHORT: Ten thousand years ago, the night elves founded a vast empire. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_ORC: The orc race originated on the planet Draenor. A peaceful people with shamanic beliefs, they were enslaved by the Burning Legion and forced into war with the humans of Azeroth. Although it took many years, the orcs finally escaped the demons' corruption and won their freedom. To this day they fight for honor in an alien world that hates and reviles them.
strings.RACE_INFO_ORC_FEMALE: The orc race originated on the planet Draenor. A peaceful people with shamanic beliefs, they were enslaved by the Burning Legion and forced into war with the humans of Azeroth. Although it took many years, the orcs finally escaped the demons' corruption and won their freedom. To this day they fight for honor in an alien world that hates and reviles them.
strings.RACE_INFO_ORC_SHORT: The orc race originated on the planet Draenor. A peaceful people with shamanic beliefs. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_SCOURGE: Once mindless slaves to the terrible Lich King, the gruesome Forsaken have overthrown his rule and now pledge loyalty to the wicked banshee queen Sylvanas. Under her reign Forsaken armies have reclaimed the ruined kingdom of Lordaeron. Every day is a struggle against vengeful humans who wish to wipe them out, and a constant battle of wills against Horde allies who distrust the sinister motives of the undead.
strings.RACE_INFO_SCOURGE_FEMALE: Once mindless slaves to the terrible Lich King, the gruesome Forsaken have overthrown his rule and now pledge loyalty to the wicked banshee queen Sylvanas. Under her reign Forsaken armies have reclaimed the ruined kingdom of Lordaeron. Every day is a struggle against vengeful humans who wish to wipe them out, and a constant battle of wills against Horde allies who distrust the sinister motives of the undead.
strings.RACE_INFO_SCOURGE_SHORT: Once mindless slaves to the terrible Lich King, the gruesome Forsaken have overthrown his rule. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_SKYBORNE: For thousands of years, a band of high elven exiles has remained safe and hidden upon their flying sanctuary of Zephras Isle. These 'Skyborne', as they call themselves, shared a bond with air elementals who kept their island aloft in the realm of Skywall. But in recent years, the elementals vanished without a trace - disrupting the delicate magic that kept them safe in their haven amongst the clouds. Now, a new generation of Skyborne elves face a time of unprecedented change and must seek new allies and sources of magic - to protect their hidden home and secure their future...
strings.RACE_INFO_TAUREN: Always the tauren strive to preserve the balance of nature and heed the will of their goddess, the Earth Mother. Many of the nomadic wandering tribes of tauren have gathered together under a single banner to settle in the fertile plains of Mulgore. Were it not for the timely intervention of the orcs, the whole race may have been wiped out by marauding centaur. The tauren honor their blood-debt to this day, fighting alongside the Horde to protect their land.
strings.RACE_INFO_TAUREN_FEMALE: Always the tauren strive to preserve the balance of nature and heed the will of their goddess, the Earth Mother. Many of the nomadic wandering tribes of tauren have gathered together under a single banner to settle in the fertile plains of Mulgore. Were it not for the timely intervention of the orcs, the whole race may have been wiped out by marauding centaur. The tauren honor their blood-debt to this day, fighting alongside the Horde to protect their land.
strings.RACE_INFO_TAUREN_SHORT: Always the tauren strive to preserve the balance of nature and heed the will of their goddess. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_TROLL: Once at home in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale, the fierce trolls of the Darkspear tribe were besieged on all sides by warring factions. The orcish Horde came to their aid, convincing the Darkspear to sail across the Great Sea and settle in the untamed lands of Kalimdor. Though they cling to their shadowy heritage, the Darkspear remain vocal advocates of a united Horde, lending the strength of their arms and powerful tribal magics to the common cause.
strings.RACE_INFO_TROLL_FEMALE: Once at home in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale, the fierce trolls of the Darkspear tribe were besieged on all sides by warring factions. The orcish Horde came to their aid, convincing the Darkspear to sail across the Great Sea and settle in the untamed lands of Kalimdor. Though they cling to their shadowy heritage, the Darkspear remain vocal advocates of a united Horde, lending the strength of their arms and powerful tribal magics to the common cause.
strings.RACE_INFO_TROLL_SHORT: Once at home in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale, the fierce trolls of the Darkspear tribe. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_VOIDELF: Seeking to harness the corruptive magic of the Void, these outcast elves endured an unexpected transformation. They are determined to master their newfound powers and resist the whispers eager to lure them into madness.
strings.RACE_INFO_VOIDELF_FEMALE: Seeking to harness the corruptive magic of the Void, these outcast elves endured an unexpected transformation. They are determined to master their newfound powers and resist the whispers eager to lure them into madness.
strings.RACE_INFO_VOIDELF_SHORT: Seeking to harness the corruptive magic of the Void, these outcast elves endured. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_VULPERA: Clever and resourceful, the vulpera of Vol'dun have survived amidst the sands for generations. Eager to join the ranks of the Horde, their caravans have departed from the dunes in search of adventure.
strings.RACE_INFO_VULPERA_FEMALE: Clever and resourceful, the vulpera of Vol'dun have survived amidst the sands for generations. Eager to join the ranks of the Horde, their caravans have departed from the dunes in search of adventure.
strings.RACE_INFO_VULPERA_SHORT: Clever and resourceful, the vulpera of Vol'dun have survived amidst the sands for generations. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_WORGEN: The worgen were first unleashed upon the Eastern Kingdoms by Archmage Arugal during the Third War. Primarily used as a weapon against the Scourge, the beasts soon proved to be a burden greater than the humans of Lordaeron could bear. A mysterious curse began to spread among those who fought alongside the wolf-men, causing them to become worgen themselves.  The curse rapidly spread as it reached Gilneas, trapping its inhabitants behind the very walls built to protect them.  The survivors of the curse now seek to find a new fate for their people -- their destiny unwritten...
strings.RACE_INFO_WORGEN_SHORT: The worgen were first unleashed upon the Eastern Kingdoms by Archmage Arugal. <PH>
strings.RACE_INFO_ZANDALARITROLL: The Zandalari are a proud people whose origins date back to the early days of Azeroth's history. Their fierce warriors ride dinosaurs into battle, and they possess one of the most formidable naval fleets in the known world.

strings.SPLASH_BASE_90_RIGHT_DESC: Azeroth is under attack! Head to the Blasted Lands to stop the Iron Horde invasion.
strings.SPLASH_BASE_FEATURE1_DESC: Check out the new Toy Box, bag improvements, and Reagent Bank.
strings.SPLASH_BASE_FEATURE2_DESC: List and browse groups for dungeons, raids, PvP, and more.
strings.SPLASH_BASE_LABEL: New in Warlords of Draenor Pre-Patch:
strings.SPLASH_BASE_RIGHT_DESC: Your character has been upgraded with higher detail and upgraded animations.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_0_2_FEATURE1: Earn updated rewards and a new seasonal mount!
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_0_2_FEATURE2: Increased challenge, better loot, and a new seasonal Keystone affix: Reaping.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_0_2_RIGHT_DE: War engulfs Zandalar as Alliance and Horde armies clash in this new raid!
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_0_FEATURE1_D: Begin the next chapter of the battle between the Horde and Alliance.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_0_FEATURE2_D: Protect your continent from enemy invasions.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_0_RIGHT_DESC: Fight for control of Darkshore in this new Warfront.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_5_FEATURE1_D: Baine Bloodhoof defies Sylvanas. Someone pays the ultimate price.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_5_RIGHT_DESC: Kul Tiran humans and Zandalari trolls join the fray!
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_FEATURE1_DES: Begin the next chapter of the battle between the Horde and Alliance.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_FEATURE2_DES: Protect your continent from enemy invasions.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_SEASON_FEATU: New armor appearances and a new season reward mount.
Higher item level rewards and a new seasonal affix: Reaping.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_1_SEASON_RIGHT: The war comes to the heart of the Zandalari Empire in this new raid.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_2_0_2_FEATURE1: Earn new rewards in Mythic Keystone dungeons and PvP.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_2_0_2_FEATURE2: Thwart the maniacal King Mechagon before he de-fleshifies all of Azeroth!
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_2_0_2_RIGHT_DE: Face Queen Azshara's most devoted champions in this new raid!
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_2_0_FEATURE1_D: Explore the long-lost island of the mechagnomes.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_2_0_FEATURE2_D: Gather Essences to infuse new powers into your Heart of Azeroth.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_2_0_RIGHT_DESC: Plunge beneath the tides into the kingdom of the treacherous naga!
Continue the War Campaign to access Nazjatar!
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_2_5_FEATURE1_D: Sync levels and quests with your friends to play together more effectively.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_2_5_FEATURE2_D: Worgen and Goblins have been updated with higher definition models.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_2_5_RIGHT_DESC: Lead the charge in the thrilling conclusion to the War Campaign.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_3_0_2_FEATURE1: Return to the front lines in this new Warfront experience.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_3_0_2_FEATURE2: Updated dungeons and PvP rewards, and the new Mythic+ affix: Awakening.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_3_0_2_RIGHT_DE: Delve into N'Zoth's Black Empire in this new raid!
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_3_0_FEATURE1_D: Face the darkness alone or with up to 4 allies and battle the horrors within.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_3_0_FEATURE2_D: New items can bear N'Zoth's touch, offering great power, at a cost.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_8_3_0_RIGHT_DESC: Defend Azeroth against the Assaults of the Old God's minions.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_BOX_FEATURE1_DES: Race against rival teams to plunder Azerite from uncharted isles.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_BOX_RIGHT_DESC_A: Search for the lost Kul Tiran fleet and battle ancient evils rising from the depths.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_BOX_RIGHT_DESC_H: Explore an ancient kingdom fraught with long-buried secrets and bloodthirsty foes.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_PREPATCH_FEATURE: These cross-realm social groups connect friends, even in different guilds.
Unlock bonus XP and honor talents by opting into world PvP on any realm.
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_PREPATCH_LABEL: New in Battle for Azeroth Pre-Launch!
strings.SPLASH_BATTLEFORAZEROTH_PREPATCH_RIGHT_D: Explore your updated class abilities and prepare to fight for the future of Azeroth!
strings.SPLASH_BOOST2_FEATURE2_DESC: You will earn your abilities while questing in Tanaan Jungle.
strings.SPLASH_BOOST2_RIGHT_DESC: Head to the Dark Portal and talk to Archmage Khadgar.
strings.SPLASH_BOOST_FEATURE1_DESC: We gave you a new set of gear and your old gear has been mailed to you.
strings.SPLASH_BOOST_FEATURE2_DESC: You will earn your abilities while questing in the Blasted Lands.
strings.SPLASH_BOOST_LABEL: Here are some tips to get you started with your boosted character!
strings.SPLASH_BOOST_RIGHT_DESC_ALLIANCE: Head to the Blasted Lands and talk to Vindicator Maraad.
strings.SPLASH_BOOST_RIGHT_DESC_HORDE: Head to the Blasted Lands and talk to Thrall.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_BASE_FEATURE1_DESC: Check out your brand new class abilities and talents.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_BASE_RIGHT_DESC: Transmogrification has been revamped to include a new Appearance collection, tabards, outfits, and more!
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_BOX_FEATURE1_DESC: Vanquish your foes with the new Demon Hunter class.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_BOX_FEATURE2_DESC: Customize your artifact and guide your faction against the Legion.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_BOX_RIGHT_DESC: Travel to the Broken Isles and unlock the power of your artifact weapon.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_1_FEATURE1_DESC: Odyn summons you to vanquish Helya, the ruler of Helheim.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_1_FEATURE2_DESC: Rally the people of Suramar and make ready to siege the Nighthold!
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_1_RIGHT_DESC: This sprawling Mythic-only dungeon awaits. Venture deep within the famed home of Medivh and fight the Legion!
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_2_5_FEATURE1_DESC: Travel through time to help Chromie prevent her own assassination!
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_2_5_FEATURE2_DESC: Revisit the Black Temple during Burning Crusade timewalking events.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_2_5_RIGHT_DESC: Battle into the depths of the Dark Titan's tomb to challenge Kil'jaeden the Deceiver, master of the Burning Legion.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_2_FEATURE1_DESC: Experience crazy new ways to play in this new PvP mode.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_2_FEATURE2_DESC: Collect and track all the appearance sets for your class.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_2_RIGHT_DESC: Return to the Broken Shore and end the Legion's invasion of Azeroth.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_3_5_FEATURE1_DESC: Revisit Ulduar during Wrath of the Lich King timewalking events.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_3_5_FEATURE2_DESC: Will the price of victory be the very lifeblood of Azeroth?
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_3_5_RIGHT_DESC: Many more zones now scale with your level. You decide where you want to quest.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_3_FEATURE1_DESC: Upgrade the relics in your artifact weapon.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_3_FEATURE2_DESC: Defeat the Void presence and expel the Shadowguard from Argus.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_NEW_7_3_RIGHT_DESC: Begin the final battle against the Burning Legion.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_PREPATCH_FEATURE1_DESC: Fend off the invading Legion army to obtain exclusive pre-launch rewards.
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_PREPATCH_FEATURE2_DESC: Includes a new Appearance collection, outfits, and more!
strings.SPLASH_LEGION_PREPATCH_RIGHT_DESC: Face off against Gul'dan alongside the heroes of the Horde and Alliance.
strings.SPLASH_NEW_6_1_FEATURE1_DESC: The new Heirlooms pane gives you easy access to all of your heirlooms.
strings.SPLASH_NEW_6_1_FEATURE2_DESC: Continue Khadgar's legendary quest to unlock an all-new legendary follower.
strings.SPLASH_NEW_6_1_RIGHT_DESC: Check out the new garrison content, including new missions and rewards!
strings.SPLASH_NEW_6_2_FEATURE1_DESC: The final campaign to defeat the Iron Horde begins here.
strings.SPLASH_NEW_6_2_FEATURE2_DESC: Construct your Shipyard, build ships, and send them on naval missions.
strings.SPLASH_NEW_6_2_RIGHT_DESC: Assault the Iron Horde's seat of power and stop the impending invasion of Azeroth.
strings.SPLASH_NEW_90_RIGHT_DESC: Head to the Dark Portal and talk to Archmage Khadgar.
strings.SPLASH_NEW_FEATURE1_DESC: Build your own personal fortress in Draenor, complete with a mighty army of followers!
strings.SPLASH_NEW_FEATURE2_DESC: Classic character models have been upgraded with higher detail and new animations.
strings.SPLASH_NEW_RIGHT_DESC: A new world of adventure awaits beyond the Dark Portal.

strings.TOL_BARAD_DESCRIPTION:
Once a mighty island citadel of Stromgarde, Tol Barad was razed and later abandoned by rampaging orcs in the Second War. Years later the island was reclaimed by Kul Tiras, and a band of wizards oversaw the construction of a vast magical prison over the fortress' ruins.

As a large-scale battle, the attacking team must simultaneously control the Ironclad Garrison, Warden's Vigil, and Slagworks to claim victory.  The attacking force may use abandoned siege vehicles to destroy the three watch towers, extending the duration of the battle.

strings.TUTORIAL14: You can go to your class trainer to learn new skills. |cffffd200Right Click|r on trainers to talk to them.|n|nTrainers are found in many towns or cities and always in your starting area. You may have to search around a little to find your trainer.

strings.TUTORIAL25: You are now a ghost. You can return to life by either finding your corpse or talking to a nearby spirit healer.|n|nYour corpse shows up as an icon in the minimap at the upper right hand portion of the screen.
strings.TUTORIAL26: You are rested. Being rested gives you a temporary bonus to experience from killing monsters.
strings.TUTORIAL27: If you stray into deep and uncharted waters, you will see a Fatigue bar. If you become completely fatigued, you will begin to drown.
strings.TUTORIAL28: Swimming is much like walking, except you can steer upwards and downwards by holding down the |cffffd200Right Mouse Button|r and looking in the direction you want to go.
strings.TUTORIAL29: You will see a Breath bar pop up when your character becomes submerged in water. If you run out of breath, you will begin to drown.

strings.TUTORIAL30: You are now resting, indicated by your portrait glowing yellow. Time spent resting or logged out gives you a temporary bonus to experience from killing monsters.|n|nYou can quickly return to inns to rest by using your hearthstone.
strings.TUTORIAL31: Hearthstones can be used to transport you from your current location to the inn where you set your hearthstone.
strings.TUTORIAL32: You are engaging in Player vs. Player combat. While you are participating in Player vs. Player combat the symbol of your alliance will appear next to your portrait and you can be attacked by enemy players.
strings.TUTORIAL33: You can press the |cffffd200Spacebar|r to make your character jump. You can use jumping to get past obstacles or just for fun.

strings.WINTERGRASP_DESCRIPTION:
An ancient Titan stronghold built to protect the Vault of Archavon.  Horde and Alliance forces battle furiously for control of the place, eager to seize the artifacts and relics held within the vault for their battle against the Lich King.

Gnome and goblin engineers work feverishly in hastily-assembled workshops to crank out the mighty siege engines attackers will need to batter down the fortress' walls and towers.
